lang: python
file: scripts/release/regenerate_public_release_hashes.py
---
def check_release_hashes(current_signature, next_signature, current_manifest, next_manifest):
    signature_ok = current_signature == next_signature
    manifest_ok = current_manifest == next_manifest
    return signature_ok and manifest_ok
